Dear Team🙏🏼
My name is Niki, and I am a representative of Siam Craft Cake Boutique.

I would like to kindly reach out with a proposal for potential cooperation.

We believe that our premium custom-made cakes and desserts can be a perfect addition to your business and your clients’ celebrations - whether you are a restaurant, café, hotel, wedding agency, event company, or any organization working with guests and special occasions.

⸻

🎂 Event Cakes - Our Main Expertise

We specialize in creating unique designer cakes and dessert tables for all kinds of events.
We can produce any style and decoration based on the theme, concept, and client’s wishes.

✨ At the moment, we are the only bakery in Pattaya offering fully handmade and completely edible fondant cake decorations.

Our cakes are not only visually outstanding, but also professional in quality and truly delicious.

⸻

🍰 Our Premium Products

Dessert Portions (5 varieties)
	1.	Cheesecake with strawberry sauce
	2.	Honey cake
	3.	Caramel cake “Anthill”
	4.	Chocolate–almond cake
	5.	Red Velvet

Price: 95 THB per piece
(Most partners resell from 150 THB and above)

Storage:
• Freezer (-25°C): up to 3 months
• Freezer (-15°C): up to 1 month
• Refrigerator: 7–14 days

⸻

🍪 Cookies (3 flavors)

• Chocolate
• Vanilla chocolate chip
• Almond

Price: 35 THB per piece (7 cm)
Orders over 100 pcs: 25–30 THB per piece

Shelf life: over 1 month

⸻

Why Partner With Us

• Over 10 years of experience
• 4 years in Thailand with 5,000+ completed orders
• Premium ingredients (Italian chocolate, Australian butter, fresh fruits)
• Strict quality control and modern equipment
• Always on-time delivery
• Special partner pricing available

⸻

Cooperation Offer

We would be truly happy to build a long-term partnership with your company.

We can provide tasting samples anytime and adjust our desserts to perfectly match your business needs and client requests🙏🏼

⸻

Kind regards,
Niki
Siam Craft Cake Boutique
